_doc: Study-visual pack for the FlyGACA Individuals funnel. One entry per SVG: which tier consumes it, how it is drawn, and where every number comes from. The pack is deterministic: `python3 content/study-visuals/build.py` rewrites out/<lang>/<id>.svg byte for byte. Values are read from shared/js/sim.js; tests/test_study_visuals.py checks every drawing against 08_realistic_digital_twin/data/poh_references.json.
aircraft: Cessna 172N, 1979 model (factory-standard educational baseline; serial-specific configuration not verified)
